supersedes.reason: A live Tauri development run exposed two post-review defects: the shared boundary component rejected valid two-part RO diagnostic identifiers and the main WebView capability omitted Tauri's narrow internal DevTools-toggle permission. This remediation restores the approved functional shell and debug-build inspector without broadening the product UI.
